scope.captureBoundary: Matrix/environment: section locator including padded field frame; real 200%: full current visible browser viewport 1264x805 physical PNG; inventory: default viewport 1280x720.

conclusions: All 150 original PNGs were opened individually at original detail, including repeated SHA images. The 54 MD3 matrix cells each have two interaction-stage PNGs.
Floating labels and outlined notches remain fully inside sampled padding; active field emphasis and clear-button outer focus contours are not cropped in light/dark and touch pictures.
Clear states show actual empty inputs with retained field focus, floating labels and placeholders; environment/zoom photos are after actual clear then refill, not images of the cleared value.

Long values are deliberately horizontally scrollable inputs. PNGs show only visible fragments; native Home/End/Select-all, retained complete value and positive scroll displacement are the separate evidence for reachability.
Touch tests use actual label/clear tap and native coarse pointer/48px control and action bounds. The PNGs visibly keep larger clear contours and icons aligned.

Real zoom proofs use chrome.tabs.setZoom from 1 to 2. html/body zoom remain 1; CSS viewport changes from1264x805 to632x402 and physical viewport capture is1264x805. No substituted viewport/DPR-only claim or full-page approval.
Material labelled fields retain documented56px minimum height across public sizes. Public size matrix coverage does not mean three distinct MD3 container heights.
No new visual defect found in this assigned MD3 Windows candidate scope.

evidence.overallNativeCoreMatrix: 162/162 across all three designs; manual review here is only MD3 54/54
evidence.overallNativeEnvironments: 60/60 across all three designs; manual review here is only MD3 20/20 including two zoom tests

rendering.driver: ANGLE (NVIDIA, NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3070 (0x00002484) Direct3D11 vs_5_0 ps_5_0, D3D11)

currentPackageSource.note: All files under components/rc-line-edit listed in candidate source match current source during this read-only review.

limitations: Windows native candidate only. No Linux canonical pixel baseline, Firefox/WebKit or cross-platform pixel equivalence approved.
No new browser capture/build/test was run by this manual review. Native passed assertions and manual picture inspection remain separate evidence.
The two inventory images cover default simple.demo.tsx viewport only, not matrix states.
Native videos were not reviewed here; PNGs do not prove transition timing or continuous animation progression.
The no-PNG configuration-preservation boundary test is engineering evidence in the native run, not counted as a manually viewed image case.
Size/density/state combinations not declared by this specification remain outside this review; standalone field density is documented not applicable beyond standard.
No baseline, verified design coverage, lifecycle or full-library completion was updated. Prior failed candidates remain unchanged.
